verdict.rationale: Link CLI documents a customer-controlled wallet from which the agent retrieves one-time-use payment credentials, with balance/transaction visibility ('reads transaction history, balances, and account details') and human approval on every spend via the Link app/website, and is confirmed live on npm by runtime probe. missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports of actually funding and using the wallet end-to-end (only vendor docs and a package-registry probe, no third-party usage account).
